evals.prompt: Create an interactive 3D terrain map centered on Mount Everest using MapLibre GL JS and MapTiler Terrain-RGB raster-dem tiles.
evals.expected_output: A complete, self-contained HTML page using native MapLibre GL JS with explicit container CSS height, raster-dem source loaded via MapTiler terrain-rgb tiles, map.setTerrain enabled with exaggeration, a sky layer configured, and proper [lng, lat] coordinate center.

evals.prompt: Build a MapLibre vector map showing earthquake locations with point clustering, dynamic cluster count bubbles, and click-to-zoom expansion.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML page using MapLibre GL JS with a GeoJSON source with cluster: true, clusterMaxZoom, clusterRadius, three circle layers styled using step expressions for count thresholds, symbol layer with text-field '{point_count_abbreviated}', and click handler querying getClusterExpansionZoom.

evals.prompt: Implement a 3D building extrusions map using MapLibre GL JS and MapTiler Planet v4 building vector tile layer.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML page with pitch set to 60 degrees, a fill-extrusion layer sourced from the vector tile 'building' source-layer, with fill-extrusion-height and fill-extrusion-base expressions, and fill-extrusion-color styling.

evals.prompt: Create a smooth animated marker moving along a GeoJSON delivery flight route at 60 FPS in MapLibre GL JS.
evals.expected_output: A standalone HTML page with a GeoJSON LineString route, Turf.js or interpolation math calculating coordinate positions over time, requestAnimationFrame loop updating a point GeoJSON source or marker coordinate, and bearing rotation.

evals.prompt: Create a serverless PMTiles map in MapLibre GL JS loading vector tiles from an archive using maplibregl.addProtocol.
evals.expected_output: A complete HTML page registering the PMTiles protocol via pmtiles.Protocol() and maplibregl.addProtocol, configuring a vector source with pmtiles:// URL, and rendering vector tile layers.
